description:
Cargo Measure turns your iPhone into a quick, paperless tool for recording inbound cargo. Create an order for each customer, measure every item, take photos, and get volume and totals ready to export, right on the warehouse floor.

WHAT IT DOES
• Create inbound orders per customer
• Measure the length × width × height of each item by walking around it
• Detects boxes and cylinders
• Take photos of every item
• Automatic volume (m³), piece count and weight totals for each order
• Type in or correct dimensions manually at any time

HOW SCANNING WORKS
Point your iPhone at the item until the frame locks on, then walk slowly around it until every segment of the ring lights up. iPhones with a LiDAR scanner measure with LiDAR. Other iPhones use the camera only, which is less precise: roughly ±3 cm in our tests. A calibration offset in Settings lets you fine-tune results against a box of known size.

REPORTS & EXPORT
• Reports by date range, by customer, or for the orders you select
• Export CSV, a PDF report, or a ZIP of photos
• Export a single order straight from the order itself

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no server, no analytics, no tracking. Orders, customers and photos stay on your device, and the app works fully offline. Exports are created only when you choose to share them.

AND ALSO
• Available in 11 languages
• A short tutorial on first launch

ACCURACY NOTE
Measurements are estimates, and accuracy is not guaranteed. It varies with the device, the object's shape and material, lighting, surroundings and scanning technique. Verify critical dimensions with a tape measure before relying on them, for example for freight charges, packing or customs. Please read the full disclaimer in the app (Settings > About).
promotionalText: Record inbound cargo in minutes: walk around a box, get its size and volume, add photos, export CSV or PDF reports. Works offline. Your data stays on your device.
